task.question: What was the highest ticket price for the 2026 FIFA World Cup final?
task.evidence: Ticket prices for the 2026 FIFA World Cup initially ranged from $60 for group stage matches to $6,730 for the final—an increase from the USD equivalent of $69 to $1,607 for the 2022 World Cup. However, in September 2025, FIFA confirmed it would use dynamic pricing for tickets for the first time, following the practice used in the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup. Special "hospitality" seats were made available in April 2025.
